meta.title: A Brief History of AI (1943–2026) · Sample
meta.subtitle: World map as base · time axis raised · nodes floating by real geo-coordinates and year (this sample loads no map texture and uses a solid-color base to demo the engine).

milestones.title: McCulloch–Pitts Neuron Model
milestones.desc: The first formal mathematical model of an artificial neuron, laying the theoretical foundation of neural networks.

milestones.title: Turing Test (Alan Turing)
milestones.desc: Turing proposed the famous criterion for judging whether a machine is intelligent.

milestones.title: Dartmouth Workshop
milestones.desc: The term 'Artificial Intelligence' was coined and the field was formally established.

milestones.title: Perceptron
milestones.desc: Rosenblatt proposed the first learnable artificial neural network model.

milestones.title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
milestones.desc: IBM's Deep Blue defeated the human world chess champion.

milestones.title: Geoffrey Hinton
milestones.desc: The 'godfather of deep learning', who drove the neural-network revival.

milestones.title: AlexNet (ImageNet)
milestones.desc: Deep learning crushed traditional methods on image recognition, igniting the wave.

milestones.title: AlphaGo beats Lee Sedol
milestones.desc: DeepMind's reinforcement-learning system defeated the Go world champion.

milestones.title: Transformer Architecture
milestones.desc: Google proposed a sequence-modeling architecture based entirely on attention.

milestones.title: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
milestones.desc: The milestone product that brought generative AI to the public.

milestones.title: GPT-4 (OpenAI)
milestones.desc: A multimodal large model with a major leap in reasoning ability.

milestones.title: Gemini 3 (Google)
milestones.desc: Google's new-generation multimodal model, deeply integrated with search and its ecosystem.
